description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform image check and upgrade procedures, including partition handling, image extraction, and device modification commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of an image against the existing device to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to a system partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs an upgrade of the device by comparing partition tables and writing image data to device partitions.
